messages:
ava: Heads-up — planning a focused terraform apply for the vpn-bastion route fix during tonight's change window (21:00 UTC). Keep it small, canary in us-west-2 first. Need provider pin + rollback plan.

mike: Scope? which modules will touch state?

ava: Only `modules/network/bastion` — route table, association, and a small secgroup tweak. Plan flagged drift on one assoc earlier.

leah: If drift showed up, we should pin provider to avoid an auto minor bump. Also add an explicit manual approval before global roll.

mike: ok, i'll push provider constraint and re-run plan. adding: 
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 4.60"
    }
  }
}
```

deploybot: preflight completed: plan OK for `modules/network/bastion` (3 resources to add/update). Detected provider constraint change — will validate module sync. Scheduled apply for 1744453200 (21:00 UTC). Canary configured: us-west-2 only, 3m health check. Auto-continue disabled (manual approval required).

ops-sre: Add escape hatch: if canary fails, abort and run rollback tag `revert network/bastion@vpn-route-fix`. Notify #incidents and page oncall. Also ensure TF state snapshot saved to s3://redwood-tf-state-backups/preapply/1744449999.tgz

ava: Good. Also create a tiny runbook comment in the PR pointing to the rollback steps and which IAM role to use for emergency revert.

mike: pushed provider pin and updated PR. Re-ran plan — no unexpected changes now. ETA to get manual approval: 20:50 UTC.

leah: I'll sign off at 20:55 after a quick drift check across accounts. If all green, approve and deploybot can run the canary. :thumbsup:

ava: Thanks. Oncall FYI: if the canary flips, do not auto-promote — follow ops-sre rollback steps and coordinate with product for customer impact comms.

mike: will be watching logs and route table propagations. ping me if any alarm.

deploybot: NOTE: apply will create a rollout note in console with link to PR and plan diff. Will post live updates in this thread when canary starts/ends.

leah: approved, marking manual approval in deploybot at 20:56 UTC.

ava: OK — moving to runway. Thanks everyone.
